info.title: SmartSend Make.com API
info.description: Public HTTP API for the SmartSend Make.com integration. Every request is authenticated with the `x-organization-id` header. These are the endpoints Make.com (and any external automation tool) calls to send messages, manage conversations, tags, lists, custom fields, and more.

organizationId.name: x-organization-id
organizationId.description: Your SmartSend Organization ID. Required on every request.

get.summary: Get RPC options for make.com dropdowns
Get custom fields for a specific list

parameters.name: listId
parameters.description: ID of the list to get custom fields from

get.summary: Get available conversation flag colors for dropdown
Get dynamic field definitions for a single approved template
get.description:
Returns flat field definitions for the dynamic parts of a single template — one entry per `{{N}}` body parameter, one per dynamic URL button (URL containing `{{1}}`), and one for the header media URL when the template has an IMAGE/VIDEO/DOCUMENT header. Used by the Make.com "Send Template" module to render dynamic fields once the user has picked a `templateName`.
Returns an empty array when `templateName` is missing — Make.com's convention is "no fields yet" rather than an error before the user has chosen a template.

parameters.name: languageCode
parameters.description: Optional language code to disambiguate templates that exist in multiple languages (e.g. `he`, `en`)

label.description: Human-readable label for the Make.com UI

get.summary: Get template parameters for all templates inside a bot flow
get.description: Scans a bot flow for template nodes and returns the parameters each template expects. Used for dynamic fields in Make.com.

parameters.name: botId
parameters.description: ID of the bot to scan for template parameters

post.summary: Send a template message by phone number
post.description: Templates can be sent anytime, even outside the 24-hour window

templateName.description: Name of the approved WhatsApp template

avoidBlacklist.description: When true, the send is skipped if the number is blacklisted.

headerMediaUrl.description: Optional public URL for header media (image/video/document). Overrides the template's default media at send time.

urlButtonParams.description:
Optional. Per-send values for dynamic URL buttons (URL contains `{{1}}` in the stored template). Two accepted shapes:
  - Positional array: `["abc", null, "xyz"]` (index = button position in template)
  - Make.com Array of Collections: `[{ "buttonIndex": 0, "value": "abc" }, ...]`
Buttons not listed (or with null/empty value) fall back to Meta's example URL.

buttonIndex.description: 0-based index of the button in the template's buttons array

value.description: The string that replaces `{{1}}` for this send

post.summary: Send a template message with a base64 file
post.description: Accepts a base64-encoded file, uploads it to CDN, then sends the template with the file as header media. Use this when you have file data (e.g. from Google Drive download) instead of a public URL.

templateName.description: Name of the approved WhatsApp template

200.description: Template message sent successfully with uploaded file

post.summary: Update display name by phone number
post.description: Sets a custom display name for the conversation. Creates the conversation if it doesn't exist.

displayName.description: Custom display name (null to reset to profileName)

post.summary: Assign a user to a conversation by phone number
post.description: Assigns the specified user to the conversation. By default this is a **replace** operation — every other user currently assigned is removed so only the target user remains. Set `replaceExisting: false` to **append** the user alongside existing assignments instead.

replaceExisting.description: When `true` (default), unassigns every other user before assigning the target user (replace). When `false`, leaves existing assignments intact and just adds the target user (append). If the target user is already assigned, this is a no-op.

post.summary: Set a custom field value on a conversation by phone number
post.description: Sets or clears a value for one of the organization-level custom fields on a conversation. Creates the conversation if it doesn't exist. Identify the field with either `fieldId` (preferred, from `/rpc/custom-fields`) or `fieldName`. Pass `value: null` to clear the field.

fieldName.description: Name of the custom field (alternative to fieldId)

value.description: Value to set. Pass null to clear.

post.summary: Set multiple custom field values on a conversation by phone number
post.description:
Bulk variant of `/conversations/set-custom-field`. Accepts an array of `{ fieldId | fieldName, value }` items and applies them all in one call. Designed for the Make.com "Array of Collections" parameter type.
Each item identifies its field with either `fieldId` (preferred, from `/rpc/custom-fields`) or `fieldName`. Pass `value: null` on an item to clear that field.
The whole batch is validated up front: if any item references an unknown field, the request fails before any updates are written.

fields.description: One or more field updates to apply

fieldName.description: Name of the custom field (alternative to fieldId)

value.description: Value to set. Pass null to clear the field.

post.summary: Set or clear the colored flag on a conversation by phone number
post.description: Pass color=null (or "none") to remove the flag. Creates the conversation if it doesn't exist.

color.description: Flag color to set. Use null or "none" to clear. Defaults to "red" when omitted.

post.summary: Send a push notification to mobile-app users
post.description:
Triggers an Expo push notification to mobile-app users of the organization. Recipient resolution depends on `recipientType`:
  - `user`         → the single `userId` provided
  - `organization` → all distinct users in the org with active devices
  - `phone`        → users currently assigned to the conversation matching `phoneNumber`

When `respectPreferences` is true (default), the resolved list is filtered by each user's `NotificationPreference` (enabled / activeHours / assignedOnly).
Sound enum maps cross-platform: on iOS the file `cash.wav` (bundled in the app) is named in the payload; on Android the `cash` notification channel is targeted (the channel binds the sound resource).

recipientType.description: How to resolve the target users

phoneNumber.description: Required when recipientType is "phone". Any format (972..., 05..., +972...)

respectPreferences.description: When true (default), apply the recipient's NotificationPreference filter (enabled, active hours, assigned-only).

404.description: No conversation found for phoneNumber (only when recipientType is "phone")
